Select: SELECT Id, Name FROM (SELECT V.Job_Id as Id, 'RFQ:' || V.Inqry_Num || ' - ' || To_char(V.Inqry_Date,'dd-mm-yyyy') || ' | OFR:' || V.Offer_Num || ' - ' || To_char(V.Offer_Date,'dd-mm-yyyy') || ' | JF:' || V.Job_Num || ' - ' || To_char(V.Job_Date,'dd-mm-yyyy') AS Name FROM Fre_VIfr_TJob_Offers V)
